name: Writhing Deep
summary: In southeastern Feralas, the Writhing Deep’s hive keeps growing and threatens nearby wildlife and encampments. Zukk'ash silithid widen their burrow, upsetting the forest’s balance.

sections.title: The Zukk'ash Swarm
sections.body: Across southeastern Feralas, the Zukk'ash swarm spreads through the lowlands. Silithid dig winding tunnels and guard their resinous eggs. As the hive grows, wild creatures grow restless and nearby gnoll packs stir. Displaced predators press close to Horde paths and native sanctuaries.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Writhing Deep?
faq.answer: Zukk'ash silithid crawl through the Writhing Deep. These giant insects include workers, tunnelers, stingers, and wasps. Dangerous brood champions such as Stinglasher and Qirot lead them.

faq.q: Why is the Writhing Deep a threat to Camp Mojache?
faq.answer: As the Zukk'ash swarm spreads, gnolls flee their hunting grounds. Frantic, they move north toward Camp Mojache and threaten the Horde outpost.

faq.q: Where is the Writhing Deep located?
faq.answer: The Writhing Deep lies in southeastern Feralas, south of the main road and east of the towering forested hills.

angles.text: Silithid spreading from the Writhing Deep threaten Camp Mojache. Crazed gnolls and roaming insect scouts press into your supply lines.
